title: QC-SVC-010 —Proposal for Research
description:
1.
FRONTEND — Visitor Display & Document Download
User Story
ID: QC-SVC-010 | US-001 REF: FR-017
Title: Proposal
for Research — Visitor Display & Document Download
As a public website visitor
I want to open the Proposal for Research page,
review the overview and guidance, and download the available template and
guidance documents
So that I can prepare and propose a research
topic to Qatar Chamber’s Research & Studies Department.
Preconditions
- The Qatar Chamber website is published and accessible.
- The Proposal for Research page and its
sections/documents are published in the CMS.
What the Visitor Sees
- Breadcrumb (Home › Services) and a hero with eyebrow,
title and description.
- A quick-facts strip (Proposal Type, Research Focus,
Primary Audience, Responsible Department).
- A sticky section index (01–03).
- Section 01 Overview — rich text and three info cards
(Clear research focus, Business guidance, Contact our experts).
- Section 02 Service information — two labeled guidance
boxes: “Preparing your proposal” and “Supporting information”, each with a
bullet list.
- Section 03 Downloadable resources — an intro and file
cards (Research Proposal Template, Research Proposal Guidelines) with type/size
and a Download button.
Frontend Workflow
- Visitor
navigates to Main Menu → Services → Proposal for Research.
- The
page loads: breadcrumb, hero, quick-facts strip, sticky section index, and all
published sections in order.
- Visitor
reads the Overview and info cards, and the Service information guidance boxes.
- Visitor
clicks Download on a resource card; the attached file downloads to the device.
Acceptance Criteria
Given the visitor opens the Proposal for
Research page
When the page renders
Then the system shall display the breadcrumb,
hero (eyebrow, title, description), the quick-facts strip, the sticky section
index, and all published sections in the configured display order.
Given the Overview section is published
When it renders
Then rich text shall support headings,
paragraphs, bullets and inline hyperlinks, and each active info card shall show
its icon, title and description in order.
Given the Service information section is
published
When it renders
Then each active information group shall
display its label, intro and bullet items in the configured order.
Given a downloadable resource is configured
When the visitor clicks Download
Then the system shall trigger a download of
the attached file; the file title, type and size shall be shown on the card.
Given the visitor toggles language (EN/AR)
When the page renders
Then all content shall display in the selected
language with correct LTR (EN) / RTL (AR) layout.
Given the page is opened on desktop, tablet or
mobile
When it renders Then the layout shall be
responsive.
Given content is draft/unpublished or a section/item
is inactive
When the page renders Then that content shall not
appear.
Edge Cases
- If the selected-language translation is missing, the
content falls back to the current/default language.
Negative Scenarios
- Draft or unpublished content (page, section, group,
resource) shall not appear on the website.
Post Condition
The visitor has
read the research proposal guidance and downloaded the available
template/guidelines documents.
2.
BACKEND — Admin CMS Management
User Story
ID: QC-SVC-010 | US-002 REF: FR-017
Title: Proposal
for Research — CMS Management
As an authorized admin user (Site Content
Editor / Site Content Author)
I want to manage the Proposal for Research
page — hero, quick-facts, Overview + info cards, Service information groups,
and downloadable resources
So that visitors can access accurate and
current research proposal guidelines and templates.
Administrator Workflow
- Admin logs into Liferay CMS and opens the Proposal for
Research page record.
- Uploads/replaces the hero banner and configures
eyebrow, title (EN/AR) and content (EN/AR).
- Manages the quick-facts strip and section index
(badge/title/order/active).
- Edits Overview body and info cards; manages Service
information groups (label EN/AR, intro EN/AR, bullet items EN/AR).
- Uploads or updates downloadable documents (title EN/AR,
file, order, active); type and size captured automatically.
- Saves as draft, previews, then publishes where
permitted.
- System shows the Liferay generic success toast (EN/AR)
and records audit logs.
Acceptance Criteria
Given the admin manages the Proposal for
Research page
When the admin saves and publishes
Then the system shall allow create, edit,
preview, publish and unpublish for the page and every section/component where
permitted.
Given the admin manages repeatable items
(facts, info cards, info groups, group items, resources)
When the admin saves
Then each item shall support add, edit,
delete/deactivate, reorder and active/inactive toggle; only active, published
items shall appear in order.
Given the admin replaces a downloadable
document
When the admin saves
Then the document shall be replaceable without
unpublishing the page; type and size shall be captured.
Given a mandatory bilingual field is missing
its Arabic value
When the admin publishes with Arabic enabled
Then publishing shall be blocked with a
validation message.
Given any change is made
When the admin acts
Then the system shall display the Liferay
generic success toast and record the change in the audit log.
Negative Scenarios
- Uploading a document of a disallowed type or over the
size limit shall be blocked.

5.
Permissions
Role
Capabilities
Site Content Editor (Site Role)
Create, edit, view, preview, publish, unpublish the page,
all sections and repeatable items (facts, info cards, info groups, resources)
where permitted.
Site Content Author (Site Role)
View and update assigned page/section content where
permitted.
Public Visitor
View published content and download the template/guidelines
documents.
6.
Business Rules
- Proposal for Research is a single consolidated
informational page.
- Only published, active content appears on the website,
in the configured display order.
- All bilingual mandatory fields require Arabic values
when Arabic is enabled; layout must honor LTR (EN) / RTL (AR).
- All create/edit/publish/unpublish actions are recorded
in the audit log; each action shows the Liferay generic success toast.
